summary.text: James Gregoire is a Republican state representative from Franklin-6 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; he is also on the ballot as a Democratic candidate, having advanced from both parties' August 11 primaries.

paragraphs.text: James Gregoire assumed office in the Vermont House on January 9, 2019, succeeding Daniel Connor.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignment for the 2019 through 2024 sessions as the Human Services Committee.
